text: In accordance with Section 9A of the Consolidated Rules of Procedure for the Property Standards Committee, as amended, each Panel shall adopt a schedule of meetings to hear appeals for each year. Please note that meetings for the Property Standards Committee, North York Panel will be held remotely until further notice.

The Property Standards Committee, North York Panel: 1. Approved the following meeting dates for 2023: - Wednesday, January 25, 2023 at 9:30 a.m. - Wednesday, March 1, 2023 at 9:30 a.m. - Wednesday, March 29, 2023 at 9:30 a.m. - Wednesday, April 26, 2023 at 9:30 a.m. - Wednesday, May 17, 2023 at 9:30 a.m. - Wednesday, June 14, 2023 at 9:30 a.m. - Wednesday, September 20, 2023 at 9:30 a.m. - Wednesday, October 18, 2023 at 9:30 a.m. - Wednesday, November 15, 2023 at 9:30 a.m. - Wednesday, December 13, 2023 at 9:30 a.m.
